meta.title: MBA Marketing & Business Analytics in Mumbai – ATLAS ISME
meta.description: Master marketing strategy with analytics. Learn consumer insights, data tools, digital skills and growth planning.

hero.title: MBA for an AI (With Dual Specialisation)
hero.lead: ATLAS ISME’s MBA is not just a degree, it’s your AI-powered launchpad into leadership. A future-ready MBA that combines strong management foundations with the power of AI and analytics.

panes.label: Overview

text.strong: Marketing + Business Analytics at ATLAS ISME

text: equips students to merge creative storytelling with data-driven decision-making. This dual specialization empowers future leaders to

semesters.title: Semester 1
semesters.text: Semester 1 builds strong foundations in communication, AI tools, and global business, while preparing students with essential leadership, planning, and career skills.

courses.text: Develops impactful communication and presentation techniques, enhancing clarity, confidence, and persuasion skills crucial for professional success, leadership roles, and collaborative workplace environments.

title.strong: Modern Age AI Tools (Generative AI Tools)

courses.text: Explores emerging generative AI technologies, enabling students to apply automation, innovation, and creativity in solving complex business problems across industries.
Provides insights into international markets, cultural diversity, economic systems, and global business trends, preparing students to make informed strategic decisions in a dynamic economy.

title.strong: Career & Leadership Development I: Career Planning and Goal Setting

courses.text: Focuses on self-awareness, career planning, and effective goal setting, guiding students toward professional growth, leadership readiness, and future career opportunities.

Learn to interpret financial statements, assess profitability, liquidity, and solvency, and apply analytical tools for strategic decision-making, valuation, and business performance evaluation in diverse industries.

courses.title: Marketing – The 21st Century Marketing
courses.text: Explore modern marketing strategies, consumer behavior shifts, digital integration, and branding innovations, equipping you to craft impactful campaigns in today’s dynamic, competitive business environment.

courses.title: Entrepreneurship & Family Business – Entrepreneurship and Family Business 101
courses.text: Gain foundational knowledge of entrepreneurship and family business dynamics, focusing on opportunity identification, innovation, governance, succession planning, and strategies to build sustainable ventures across generations.

title.strong: Business Analytics – Driving Decisions by Excel (Basics & Advanced)

courses.text: Master Excel tools from basics to advanced analytics, learning data organization, visualization, forecasting, and decision modeling to transform raw data into actionable business insights.

title.strong: Digital Marketing & Advertising – Introduction to Digital Marketing

courses.text: Understand the fundamentals of digital marketing, including SEO, social media, content strategies, and analytics, to design campaigns that drive engagement, brand growth, and conversions.

compare.title: Why our semester 1 curriculum outpaces every other business school
compare.text: ATLAS ISME combines practical finance and digital marketing skills with AI and communication training, unlike traditional MBAs’ theory-focused and less tech-integrated approach.

semesters.title: Semester 2
semesters.text: Semester two develops leadership, sustainability, and design thinking with applied marketing and analytics, enabling data-driven, strategic decision-making for modern managers.

courses.text: Develops leadership, interpersonal effectiveness, and team collaboration. Students engage in role-play, psychometric assessments, and experiential exercises to enhance communication and influence.
Introduces empathy-driven problem solving. Students prototype, iterate, and test user-centric solutions for practical business and marketing challenges.
Explores sustainable business practices aligned with global SDGs. Students conduct research on CSR initiatives and assess ethical and societal impact.

title.strong: Career & Leadership Development II: Personal Branding & Professional Networking

courses.text: Focuses on personal branding, LinkedIn optimization, and networking skills. Students create professional portfolios, engage in mentorship, and build strategic connections.

items.text: Explore how societies, cultures, and communities function and influence human behavior. Understand the social forces that shape markets, organizations, and decision-making in the real world.
Focuses on brand strategy, product lifecycle, and marketing mix decisions. Students design actionable brand plans and evaluate campaign effectiveness.
Introduces regulations, compliance, and ethical standards in marketing. Students analyze real-world advertising, branding, and sales cases for responsible practices.
Explores international marketing strategies, cross-cultural branding, and market entry. Students design campaigns and evaluate positioning in global contexts.
Covers descriptive, inferential, and multivariate statistics for managerial decision-making. Students analyze datasets and interpret results to inform strategy.
Introduces regression, classification, and forecasting models. Students apply predictive analytics to real-world business problems for actionable insights.

semesters.title: Semester 3
semesters.text: Semester three integrates analytics, machine learning, and data-driven marketing with leadership development, preparing students for strategic, informed, and responsible decision-making roles.

title.strong: Organisational Behaviour and Universal Human Values

courses.text: Explores individual and group behavior, ethical decision-making, and value-driven leadership. Students apply human-centric principles to enhance workplace culture and collaboration.
Introduces cybersecurity frameworks, risk management, and incident response. Students engage with real-world case studies to protect digital business assets.
Applies micro and macroeconomic concepts to managerial contexts. Students analyze pricing, demand-supply, and market structures for informed decision-making.

title.strong: Career & Leadership Development III: Emotional Intelligence & Resilience

courses.text: Develops self-awareness, adaptability, and resilience in leadership. Students participate in coaching, reflective exercises, and simulations for practical skill-building.

items.text: Covers data-driven decision-making using marketing metrics, KPIs, and analytics tools. Students interpret campaign and consumer data to optimize strategies
